title: 第一卷 第111章 差点被糟蹋了！
slug: 重生1989我一赌鬼带全家顿顿吃肉
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

王建军刚骑着摩托车走出了没多远，突然听见前方有动静，而且那动静刚好是白天晴离开的方向！

王建军来不及多想，立刻调转了摩托车的方向，开了过去。

眼下，他只希望是自己听错了。

可过了两个巷子，王建军果然发现有几个小混混围在一起。

而旁边被随意扔在一旁的自行车，赫然就是白天晴骑的那个。

这下王建军还有什么想不明白的，立刻从旁边拿起一块砖头就冲了上去。

“你们这些畜牲，把她给我放开。”

王建军说着，也发了狠，直接一砖头砸了过去。

其中离他最近的那个混混，当场后背就流了血。

而王建军也看见了，被他们围住的白天晴。

好在他来的及时，白天晴的衣服虽然被扯开了，但他们还没来得及做什么。

“王大哥！”

这个时候看到王建军，白天晴再也忍不住了，红了眼睛，哭出了声，朝着他扑了过去，躲在了他的身后。

刚才那一刻，她真的吓坏了。

毕竟她刚才骑着自行车，正准备拐弯时，这几个混混突然窜了出来，把她拽到了这个角里。

甚至其中一人，直接用那脏手捂住了她的嘴，她都没来得及喊出声。

就在白天晴以为，自己今天晚上就要被糟蹋，人生再也没有指望的时候，王建军却出现了。

“别怕，在我后面躲好了。”

王建军这话，让白天晴的心一下子踏实了下来。

哪怕只有王建军一个人，可只要有他在，白天晴就觉得没有什么好怕的。

“一个人还想英雄救美，兄弟们，给我上，今天咱们就当着他的面把这个女的给玩了。”

“我倒要看看，他一个人怎么打得过咱们这么多人！”

刚刚被打的背后出血的男人，恶狠狠的说着。

听到这话，那四五个小混混立刻将王建军围住了。

但这种小场面，王建军上辈子见过无数回，连眉头都不带皱的。

直接看准一个人，又是一板砖下去，瞬间那人脑袋就开了花。

这下，那群小混混都被王建军的狠劲给吓住了。

Page (1/3)

Wang Jianjun had just ridden his motorcycle not far away when he suddenly heard movement in front of him, and the movement happened to be in the direction Tian Qing left!

Wang Jianjun didn't have time to think too much, he immediately turned the direction of the motorcycle and drove over.

At the moment, he just hoped that he had heard wrong.

But after passing two alleys, Wang Jianjun found a few gangsters gathered around him.

The bicycle that was casually thrown aside was the one that Tian Qing was riding.

At this time, Wang Jianjun still had something he couldn't figure out, so he immediately picked up a brick from the side and rushed forward.

"You beasts, let her go."

As Wang Jianjun spoke, he also became fierce and hit him with a brick.

The gangster closest to him was bleeding from his back on the spot.

And Wang Jianjun also saw Bai Tianqing surrounded by them.

Fortunately, he arrived in time. Although Bai Tianqing's clothes were torn off, they didn't have time to do anything.

"Brother Wang!"

Seeing Wang Jianjun at this time, Bai Tianqing couldn't bear it anymore, her eyes turned red, she cried, and rushed towards him, hiding behind him.

At that moment, she was really scared.

After all, she was riding a bicycle just now and when she was about to turn a corner, these gangsters suddenly jumped out and dragged her into this corner.

Even one of them directly covered her mouth with his dirty hands, and she didn't even have time to shout.

Just when Bai Tianqing thought that she was going to be ruined tonight and had no hope in life anymore, Wang Jianjun appeared.

"Don't be afraid, just hide behind me."

Wang Jianjun's words made Bai Tianqing feel at ease.

Even if Wang Jianjun was alone, as long as he was around, Bai Tianqing felt that there was nothing to be afraid of.

"A man still wants to be a hero and save a beautiful woman. Come on, brothers. Let's play with this girl in front of him today."

"I want to see how he can defeat so many of us by himself!"

The man whose back was bleeding just after being beaten said viciously.

Upon hearing this, the four or five gangsters immediately surrounded Wang Jianjun.

But Wang Jianjun had seen this kind of small scene countless times in his previous life, and he didn't even frown.

He looked directly at a person and knocked down another brick. In an instant, that person's head was blown.

At this time, the gangsters were frightened by Wang Jianjun's fierceness.
